resources.string: Lets TV Control move focus, press OK and type into search boxes for you.

TV Control uses accessibility to act as a remote control for this device: it moves focus around the screen (directional navigation), presses OK/Back/Home, and types text into fields that are focused. It reads the current screen only to know what is on it (for example the label of the focused item) so your phone or the assistant can make sense of it. Nothing is sent off your local network.
